claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance than their counterparts (F, T, W).
DNN models achieved an accuracy score of 78.5% and F1 scores of 0.94 and 0.95 for different datasets.
Transfer learning improved recall scores significantly compared to traditional models.
DNN models coupled with transfer learning outperformed traditional machine learning models across all datasets.
